title: Degree-zero continuity for a canonical relative section cocone
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category, D:I→Sch a small nonempty cofiltered diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a qcqs limit cone. Fix a stage i, an A-valued small-étale sheaf G on D_i, and a qcqs étale object U over D_i. Evaluation at U of the explicit relative-section cocone from def-weil-pbc-grothendieck-etale-relative-section-diagram is a colimit in A. This statement involves neither hypercovers nor cochain complexes nor cohomology.

external.place: Tag 09YQ, degree zero (abelian coefficients); arbitrary Grothendieck coefficients by the categorical finite-matching argument stated in the proof

proof.text: Restrict to the cofiltered category of stages mapping to i; its forgetful functor is initial, so the cone remains limiting. Finite-presentation descent of qcqs étale objects, their morphisms and their equalities, together with descent of finite covers, identifies the qcqs étale basis at the limit with the filtered colimit of stage bases. On that basis, the presheaf inverse-image formula is the pointwise filtered colimit of stage sections. Refine any cover of a qcqs object to a finite affine cover; its pairwise intersections are qcqs. The sheaf matching diagram is a finite equalizer between finite products. AB5 commutes these finite limits with the filtered colimit, so the presheaf colimit is already a sheaf on the basis. Uniqueness of inverse image identifies it with the limit inverse-image sheaf. The adjunction-unit normalization identifies its comparison legs with the explicit canonical cocone, giving the stated colimit. Empty objects are handled by the empty-cover terminal-object condition.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeSectionCocone_isColimit
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    (c : Cone D) [CompactSpace c.pt] [QuasiSeparatedSpace c.pt]
    (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I) (G : Sheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology A)
    (U : (D.obj i).Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left] :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (((evaluation _ A).obj (op U)).mapCocone
      (relativeSectionCocone A D c i G)))
